summary: Frontend-only UI test of Aqua Smart Monitoring System (Expo web preview, mobile viewport 390x844). Verified sign-in, Dashboard, History, Alerts, Settings validation, thresholds, sign-out, and all 6 demo scenarios. Core flows work. Found 2 potentially critical issues: (A) The `missing` demo scenario does not take effect from Settings — Dashboard continues to show previous scenario values and the demo-mode-banner continues to say 'Scenario: Normal readings' (temperature/DO never collapse to '--' / NO DATA). (B) Switching Data Source to `Real Pi API` from Demo via the Segmented control does not reset the Dashboard — demo-mode-banner remains visible, badge still reads 'DEMO DATA', and demo values are rendered even though we are supposedly in Real mode (direct violation of 'never show demo values as live'). Also noted: `test connection` on web preview correctly fails (expected) with 'Pi did not respond'. URL validation errors fire correctly for empty, localhost, and public-IP inputs; a valid LAN URL is normalised to `http://192.168.1.50:8000`. Thresholds card shows the 'Demo thresholds – not approved' label and 3 rows. Sign-out from Settings — a verified sign-out click did not reliably return to the sign-in screen in our run (persistent session on next reload). Scenarios STALE, UNREACHABLE, MALFORMED, NO_ALERTS work as specified. Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none.

ui_bugs.issue: Selecting demo-scenario-missing from Settings does not propagate to Dashboard. The demo-mode-banner text still reads 'Scenario: Normal readings.' and sensor cards keep the previous scenario's non-null values. Expected: temperature + dissolvedOxygen value show '--' and status 'NO DATA' (per demoData.ts i===0 nulls).

After tapping data-mode-selector-real with a saved LAN URL, Dashboard still renders demo data (demo-mode-banner visible, connection-badge-label='DEMO DATA', demo pH/temp/DO values shown). Spec says Real mode must never render demo values as live and should instead show an error/unreachable state. qc.removeQueries() + mode change does not appear to drive the UI into real-source fetch path during the test window.

After tapping sign-out-button we could not reliably return to the sign-in screen (next page load auto-landed on Settings as a signed-in user). Needs explicit router.replace('/sign-in') or clear persisted session + navigation.

integration_issues.issue: demoScenario state change not reflected by the dashboard latest/history queries for the 'missing' value specifically. STALE/UNREACHABLE/MALFORMED/NO_ALERTS all work.
Dashboard never transitions to real-source error/unreachable UI (no dashboard-error-banner, no 'UNREACHABLE' badge) when Real Pi API is selected with a saved LAN URL in web preview.

issues: Sensor-card STALE tag overlaps the Water Temperature value (visible in STALE scenario screenshot — '30.0' value is clipped by the yellow STALE pill on the right edge of the card). Consider moving the STALE pill to the header row next to the status chip or stacking it below.
Minor: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' console warning from phosphor-react-native/svg (non-blocking).

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning in console: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely from react-native-svg usage inside phosphor icons. Non-blocking but should be tracked. Reference: console log on sign-in screen.

action_items: Investigate why selecting demo-scenario-missing does not update demoScenario in SettingsContext (or why the dashboard query does not pick up the new scenario). Verify setDemoScenario is called with 'missing' and that storage.setItem resolves. Check if any guard inside buildDemoRawReadings('missing') is throwing silently.

Fix mode switch demo->real: calling qc.removeQueries() after setMode should force useLatestReading/useAlertHistory etc. to refetch with real source. In the web preview we saw no refetch happening — the dashboard kept the previously-cached demo rows. Consider calling qc.invalidateQueries() instead of/in addition to removeQueries, or awaiting setMode state propagation before clearing.

Fix sign-out navigation: in signOut flow explicitly call router.replace('/sign-in') (or rely on root _layout redirect when session=null) and ensure the persisted session token is cleared from storage. Reload after sign-out currently keeps the user signed in.
Dashboard SensorCard: avoid STALE pill overlapping the value in portrait mode (observed clipping in STALE scenario).
Track phosphor-react-native pointerEvents deprecation (upgrade phosphor-react-native when a fix is available, or wrap icons in a View with style.pointerEvents).
critical_code_review_comments: settings.tsx changeMode uses qc.removeQueries() with no await of state propagation — React may still render the Dashboard with the previously-fetched demo cache. Prefer invalidateQueries + await state (or key off `mode` in the Dashboard effect to show a loading state until the new source resolves).

SettingsContext storage.setItem is fire-and-forget; UI depends on in-memory state only, which is fine, but there is no error logging if setItem fails. For scenario changes specifically, a console.log around setDemoScenario would help triage the MISSING-scenario-no-op issue.

demoSource.getLatest() does not short-circuit for `missing`; it relies on mapLatestReading to pass null values through. Confirm mapLatestReading preserves null temperature_c and dissolved_oxygen_mg_l (otherwise the demoScenario path is fine but the mapper swallows nulls).

AuthContext/signOut should both clear persisted session AND navigate to /sign-in; current flow seems to only clear in-memory state, so a web reload re-hydrates the tab router at (tabs) and skips the sign-in gate.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (8/10 critical flows pass; MISSING scenario + Real-mode switch + sign-out-routing fail)

seed_data_creation: None — demo data is baked into src/api/demoData.ts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile viewport 390x844. Sign in with farmer / demo1234 via fill-demo-credentials-button + sign-in-submit-button. Dashboard renders sensor-card-{ph,temperature,dissolvedOxygen} with -value and -status child testIDs. The three REPRO scenarios are: (1) demo-scenario-missing -> Dashboard should show temp/DO as '--' and NO DATA, (2) data-mode-selector-real with saved URL -> Dashboard should enter error/unreachable state and NEVER show demo-mode-banner, (3) sign-out-button -> should route back to sign-in. On the web preview Test Connection always fails ('Pi did not respond') — this is expected. All demo scenario testIDs are reachable but may require scrollBy inside Settings before clicking. URL normalisation adds http:// scheme (verified).
rca_of_issue: Likely root cause for the MISSING + Real-mode bugs is the same: Dashboard latest/history queries do not actually refetch when demoScenario or mode changes in some code paths. React Query keyed with [mode, baseUrl, demoScenario] should trigger a new fetch — but qc.removeQueries() at the moment of switching mode (settings.tsx:changeMode) wipes the current cache WITHOUT awaiting the new render, and the next tab-focus can re-trigger a fetch with the OLD cached data in the view. For sign-out, AuthContext likely does not call router.replace, leaving the tabs mounted. Reproduction: (a) sign in, (b) Settings > scroll > tap demo-scenario-missing, (c) switch to Dashboard tab, (d) observe demo-mode-banner still reads 'Scenario: Normal readings' and sensor cards keep previous values; (e) similarly tap data-mode-selector-real with saved http://192.168.1.50:8000 and the dashboard keeps demo UI. Mitigation: use qc.invalidateQueries() keyed by ['latest'], ['history'], ['alerts'], ['thresholds'] AFTER setMode/setDemoScenario, and add a `key={mode+scenario}` on the Dashboard screen to force remount, or guard the Dashboard with a loading indicator while React Query refetches.
